content:
The test image shows a very young soybean seedling emerging from moist soil with the cotyledons appearing brown, shriveled, and collapsed — classic post-emergence damping off. The tissue looks soft and rotted, not firm/dry. The reference images for Pythium damping off show nearly identical scenes: seedlings at soil level with collapsed, rotted cotyledons in wet soil conditions.
